label: Pause all runs
description: Stops every tenant's workflow from starting or advancing. Running steps finish.

label: Block money moves
description: Denies every payment, refund and payout step, whatever a tenant's policy says.

label: Block external email
description: Holds every outbound customer email for approval.

label: Disable new sign-ups
description: Stops new workspaces from being created from the public site.

label: Judge, evaluate, verify nodes
description: Turns on the judge-evaluate-verify decision node in new workflow runs.

label: Reviewer marketplace open
description: Lets approved reviewers claim human tasks from the open marketplace.

label: Auto-approve memory
description: Saves proposed workspace memory without waiting for a person.

label: Platform daily AI cap
description: Most the platform spends on Gemini on Vertex AI in one day, across all tenants.

label: Concurrent runs per tenant
description: Most workflow runs one tenant can have in progress at once.

label: Human task SLA
description: Minutes before an unclaimed human task is escalated.
